survey.title: Pairwise Comparisons Survey
survey.scenario: You need to understand how RON scheduling works (Remote Online Notarization — where the signing is done fully online). You want to ask who is responsible for setting the RON appointment, where you can see the Signing Room, and when the confirmed details — like date, time, and notary info — will appear.
